desc:
Global Anarchy is an arcadey modern warfare FPS!

💥 Intense FPS combat
🎯 Earn XP by eliminating players and completing objectives
📈 Unlock perks, guns, grenades, and killstreaks as you level up
🔫 Progress individual weapons with attachments, proficiencies, and skins
🔥  Can you dominate the battlefield?!

💖 If you enjoyed the game, please leave a 👍 like! It helps us out a ton! 💫
🖥️ This game is heavily under development

Disclaimer:
